verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published per-unit pricing (per search, per record, or per node) that would let a founder predict costs upfront; only vague marketing claims like '50% the cost of Datadog' with no pricing tables or calculators. Community evidence actively describes Elastic's pricing model as opaque and confusing (e.g., 'crappy pricing model', licensing fees eating into profits), reinforcing the absence of transparent published pricing.
